name: Sikalastic®-777
summary: Sikalastic®-777 is a high performance, hand-applied, low VOC, moisture-curing single component elastomeric polyurethane membrane with excellent root-resistance properties.
metaDescription: Sikalastic®-777 is a high performance, hand-applied, low VOC, moisture-curing single component elastomeric polyurethane membrane with excellent root-resistance properties.
attributes: Low VOC, complies with Green Star requirements
High elongation, Class III membrane >300% according to AS/NZ4858
usage: Sikalastic®-777 is designed for the following waterproofing applications:
advantages: Low VOC, complies with Green Star requirements
High elongation, Class III membrane >300% according to AS/NZ4858

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: AS/NZS 4654.1:2012- Waterproofing membranes for external above-ground

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text: In normal conditions, Sikalastic®-777 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic®-777 after one night and within 2 days. In case of rain or if the recoating interval was exceeded, light abrasion and reactivate Sikalastic®-777 with Sika Thinner C or for the best results remove the existing coating back to substrate and re-apply.

items.label: Drying time
items.text: Sikalastic®-777 can be subject to light foot traffic after 24 hours.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Surface must be clean, sound, smooth and dust-free as well as oil-free. In the case of a high porosity substrate, it is recommended to use an epoxy primer. Please see 'priming' section below for further information.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Reusable tools should be cleaned carefully with Sika Thinner C before curing.
